content: <thought>The dominant peak at m/z 100.0524 is the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral mass of ~99.045 Da. The formula C₅H₇O₂ has a monoisotopic mass of 99.0446 Da, matching the neutral mass within 0.0006 Da. The observed M+1 intensity (~5.6 %) corresponds to the expected 13C contribution from five carbons (~5.5 %). Therefore the molecular formula is C5H7O2.
